import json,glob
def walk(o,found):
    if isinstance(o,dict):
        if o.get("base_url","").startswith("https://obscurify"):
            found.append(o)
        for v in o.values(): walk(v,found)
    elif isinstance(o,list):
        for x in o: walk(x,found)
res=[]
for f in glob.glob("/var/openhands/conversations/*/events/*.json"):
    try: d=json.load(open(f))
    except: continue
    found=[]; walk(d,found)
    for o in found:
        cfg={k:(v[:14]+"..." if k=="api_key" and isinstance(v,str) else v) for k,v in o.items() if not isinstance(v,(dict,list))}
        if cfg: res.append((f.split("/")[4][:8],cfg))
seen=set()
for conv,cfg in res:
    key=json.dumps(cfg,sort_keys=True)
    if key in seen: continue
    seen.add(key)

    print(f"--- conversation {conv} ---")
    for k,v in cfg.items(): print(f"   {k}: {v}")
